4/16/26, 6:42 AM - Lapis Q: In modal analysis, "modal" refers to the modes of vibration (also known as natural modes, normal modes, or eigenmodes) of a structure.
4/16/26, 6:43 AM - Lapis Q: Key aspects of "modal" in this context include:

 *Mode Shapes:* The specific, characteristic pattern of deformation a structure takes when it vibrates at a certain frequency.

 *Natural Frequencies:* The specific frequencies at which a structure prefers to oscillate.

 *Modal Parameters:* The collection of natural frequencies, mode shapes, and damping ratios that define the "modal model" of an object.
